subject: 20260512 ACME renewal + expansion recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: 20260512 ACME renewal + expansion recap

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of discussion
- Current usage: ~2M tokens/day across customer-facing chat and nightly batch embeddings (see attached APR usage report).
- Pain points:
  • Latency spikes during peak hours causing timeouts for web chat (target 95p latency < 300ms).
  • Cost: rising per-token costs as feature usage grows — need options to optimize unit economics.
  • Governance: security team asked for SOC2 artifact and data retention policy for review.
- Goals for renewal/expansion:
  • Renew existing hosted capacity for next 12 months.
  • Add Dedicated pool for high-throughput embeddings workload (initial 2 GPUs, scale to 6 by Q4).
  • Reduce token unit cost by 20–30% through batching + quantized model path for embeddings.

Agreed next steps
1) I’ll share an updated pricing proposal and Dedicated sizing recommendation by EOD Friday (attached — ACME_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf).
2) Alice to confirm internal procurement timeline and any additional questions by next Wednesday (5/19).
3) Neha and Lukas to assemble SOC2 evidence and data-retention summary for Alice’s security team (I’ve CC’d them).
4) Schedule a technical sizing call (30 min) next week to map batching/throughput requirements — proposed slots in the Doc above.

Timeline 
- Proposal & Dedicated sizing: 5/15
- Procurement kickoff: 5/19
- Target signed renewal: by 6/5 to avoid interrupting service during seasonal ramp

Open items / asks for ACME
- Confirm expected Q3 peak tokens/day for embeddings and chat (will determine GPU sizing).
- Any procurement constraints (PO only, contract signers) or legal requirements aside from SOC2?

Attachments
- ACME_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf (pricing + Dedicated sizing)
- usage_report_APR2026.csv (usage breakout by product)

Thanks — let me know if I missed anything.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 20260512 ACME renewal + expansion recap

Thanks Marissa — this is great, appreciate the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Usage: we expect embeddings to grow to ~4M tokens/day by Aug with the new batch job; chat growth will be more modest (~2.5M). I’ll send a short note with the projected weekly schedule so you can size autoscaling.
- Procurement: procurement prefers to issue a PO and may require standard vendor terms; legal will review the contract — timeline looks feasible but I’ll confirm by 5/19.
- Security: we have a SOC2 checklist; please have Neha send the evidence package and data-retention statement to security@acme.com.

One question on the proposal: the Dedicated sizing calls for 2x A10 GPUs initially — can you confirm if there’s a recommended burst policy to handle spikes without immediately adding GPUs? Also would like a high-level cost delta between keeping everything hosted vs. moving embeddings to Dedicated (annualized).

If you can include the burst policy and a 12-month cost comparison in the updated proposal, we’ll be in good shape for the procurement conversation. Looking forward to the tech sizing call — Wednesday 5/20 10:00am PT works for us.

- I’m pulling together the SOC2 evidence pack and the data retention/ingestion flow diagram. Expect to send to security@acme.com by EOD Thursday (5/14).
- Lukas — can you draft the Dedicated burst policy options (burst to 4 GPUs for short windows; warm standby instance) and include cost delta scenarios (hosted-only vs Dedicated embeddings) in the proposal v3a? If you can get that by Friday morning I’ll merge into the proposal and share with Alice.
